checks.text:
The keeper's log.
23 JULY. 1610. The estate gardener came up for supplies again. Said the dogs have got out.
0305. Woman from the lot, bitten by a dog. Bad. Phone's dead. Bandaged her, sent her up in 4 to Hal. He's got the radio.
0340. Something at the window.
A kettle on the hotplate. Stone cold.

Blood all over the counter. This is where he bandaged her.
The first aid cabinet's been emptied.
The window's been smashed in from outside. Something came through here.

The keeper. They dragged him into the machine room.
The wheel's stopped.
Keys on a board. SHED. GATE. PUMP. One hook's empty: DRIVE.
His coat's still on the hook. He never left.

ARKLAY SKYWAY, 1996. Built with the support of the Umbrella Corporation.
Umbrella. Again.
A CB radio. Static on every channel.

notes: high in the south-west corner: the bloody counter, the doorway to the machine room and him beyond it
high in the south-east corner over the desk: the counter, the smashed window, the key board
high in the north-east corner by the doorway: the desk, the log and the radio, the door out to the yard
